name: Makoto Nakagawa
source:
Reasonably mulish leader of the Nagasaki Vigilante.

 ⸺ The Edo Vigilante is a topic not easily broached without much contention on his side.

[spoiler] ⸺ Is filling the role intended for his elder brother, [url=/c67492]Toru[/url], whose whereabouts have been unknown for quite some time.[/spoiler]
